external_owner_action: Declare the pre-provisioned Nutimo/Tempo2/Boost/Minuit environment; do not report dependency repair as science.
required_input: public Nutimo source/data release and runnable environment
validation_rule: must identify code release, data release, executable path, and whether residuals plus finite gradients can be computed
notes: This keeps the pilot from becoming an infrastructure project.

external_owner_action: Export active fit parameters, delay flags, specialcase flag, target carrier list, and any harmonic nuisance blocks.
required_input: baseline par/tim and active Nutimo run configuration
validation_rule: RN_PL-like or equivalent harmonic soak-up must be explicitly listed as enabled or disabled for the target carriers
pass_interpretation: standard finite state/geometry core is testable
fail_interpretation: collapse if target-carrier harmonic soak-up is enabled
notes: This is the first stop rule from Request 10.7.

external_owner_action: Extract the three target carrier frequencies: Omega_in, Omega_out, abs(Omega_in-Omega_out).
required_input: inner/outer periods and outer-dipole combination component
validation_rule: frequencies must be positive, distinct, nonresonant at the 2:1 collapse cases, and nonzero in projection
fail_interpretation: falls back to weaker two-carrier or one-carrier gate
notes: This is not a new harmonic search; it uses existing GR carriers.

external_owner_action: Compute residual derivatives with respect to the standard finite fitted parameter set near the baseline solution.
required_input: runnable residual function and fitted parameter scales
validation_rule: columns must correspond to named fitted parameters, not carrier-local Fourier amplitudes
pass_interpretation: finite nuisance span is available for rank test
notes: This is the minimal useful runtime calculation before posterior work.

external_owner_action: Project the finite nuisance Jacobian onto the six real coordinates of the three carrier complex amplitudes.
validation_rule: rank <= 5 supports finite shared phase/geometric manifold; rank 6/6 is the per-carrier complex collapse class
pass_interpretation: dynamic-chi remains runtime-motivated if test column also survives
fail_interpretation: named implementation behaves like carrier-local soak-up
notes: Report singular values and rank threshold, not just an integer.

external_owner_action: Construct the synthetic shared-tau residual column using G(z)=c_Y+beta/(1+tau_chi z) on the target carriers.
required_input: chosen tau_chi, beta, c_Y, carrier amplitudes, and projection convention
validation_rule: column must be tested for membership in the finite nuisance Jacobian span
fail_interpretation: dynamic-chi collapses into named finite nuisance span
notes: Use several finite tau_chi values away from zero-frequency collapse.

external_owner_action: Inject the shared-tau carrier perturbation and refit only the standard finite nuisance parameters.
required_input: baseline residuals, finite Jacobian or fit routine, dynamic_chi_test_column
validation_rule: post-refit carrier relation must be tested against one shared tau_chi and against the admitted finite derivative comparator
notes: This is a sanity pilot, not a detection or final posterior.

external_owner_action: Return a one-page verdict using the exact labels: runtime-motivated, conditional, collapse.
validation_rule: must state which stop rule triggered, or why external runtime work is promoted
pass_interpretation: dynamic-chi is a named runtime-worthy positive branch
fail_interpretation: dynamic-chi closes for this named implementation class
notes: Do not convert a failed pilot into an open-ended source chase.
